title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00103 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Pulled up and observed 10t overpull
00:15 - 01:00: POOH spear BHA and inspected same, spear OK
01:00 - 02:15: Broke off 12,25 guide sleeve. P/u single DC
02:15 - 02:45: RIH spear BHA to 155m. L/d single for space out. M/u TDS to string
02:45 - 04:00: Engaged spear to fish 155m. Pulled 8t overpull. Slacked off weight. Spear released. RIH spear to 156m. Engaged spear and pulled to 270t overpull). Fish is not free. Moved string up/down between 150t-270t several times. Fish not free. Pulled in steps to MAX 320t on martin decker overpull). Measured stretch in pipe 3,2m. Estimated neutral point depth 2300m
04:00 - 05:00: Released spear. POOH to surface. R/b spear in derrick. Observed damage on grapple
05:00 - 05:30: Cleaned drill floor
05:30 - 06:00: P/u cutter BHA
06:00 - 07:15: RIH w/ cutter BHA to 169 m
07:15 - 07:30: Installed auto slips
07:30 - 08:00: RIH from 169 m to 692 m. Filled string
08:00 - 09:45: Waited on further instructions, meanwhile carried ou rig floor maintenance and PM
09:45 - 10:30: RIH from 692m to 1600m
10:30 - 10:45: Filled string
10:45 - 12:15: RIH from 1600m to 2340m. Picked up 2 singles from deck for space out
12:15 - 12:45: Took cutting parameters and cut CSG at 2361m with 330 LPM, 100 RPM, 9-11 KNM
12:45 - 18:00: Observed overpull when picking up work string between 138t and 300t on martin decker. String stuck 2362m. Tried to work string free. MAX pulled to 320t, MAX torque 40knm, sat down all string weight. No success to get string free. Evaluated further steps, started mobilizing WL cutter equipment to cut inside DP.
18:00 - 19:00: Waited on further instructions, meanwhile drillfloor prepared to work on PRS
19:00 - 00:00: Waited for WL cutting equipment and personnel to be mobilized. Meanwhile worked on repairing forward PRS
